description.value: Kelly & Carlos O'Bryan's is an Irish-themed neighborhood restaurant and pub chain with a Courtenay outpost that has been serving the Comox Valley for over six years. Situated right off Highway 19A at the entrance to Courtenay, it offers full lunch and dinner service, a daily happy hour, and an extensive drinks menu spanning Irish pints to BC wines. It is part of a well-established regional BC chain known for consistent pub fare in a lively atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Courtenay location page confirms the business is open and active, with current specials and a 2026 golf tournament promotion. The website shows a different phone number — (250) 338-2308 — than the OSM record (+1-250-474-0773), so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. Gluten-friendly items are explicitly noted on the kids menu, and the app/online ordering reference supports a takeout offering; no bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-474-0773 but the Courtenay location page on the website clearly shows (250) 338-2308. The website value has been used; OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant and pub confirmed open via current website content. A solid stop for touring cyclists seeking a full meal near the Highway 19A corridor into Courtenay.
